card.name: Words just before government terms
card.fires_on: Small words like the, a, any, and commas that sit right before a word such as Federal, State, Union or Government. It fires in political and legal text about governments and agencies.

modes.label: Article before a government body
modes.description: The word the or any comes just before a national or state authority term.
modes.example: Legislature tendered to the President all the power of the State to sup port<< the>> Federal Government Virginia Legis lature

modes.label: Comma in a list of governments
modes.description: A comma in a list of government levels, where State or local comes next.
modes.example: partial support from other Federal<<,>> State, and local agencies

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict State, Government, Federal and Nation as the next word.
card.plain: It marks a spot where the next word is likely to be State, Federal or Government.
